description: Page through every covered laptop and Chromebook model; use it only to browse or enumerate. To test whether a brand, model or part type is covered at all use get_coverage, for one model's parts use get_model_parts, and to find a model from free text use resolve_request or search_parts. Order: reliability tier (green = verified on the OEM site, then yellow, then red), then slug A to Z. brand and category both apply when given (AND). Paging: follow next_cursor (null on the last page); pages are stable for the same data_revision, and total is the full filtered count. Read-only.

brand.description: Optional manufacturer, exact name but case-insensitive, e.g. "Lenovo", "Dell", "HP" (see get_coverage brands).

cursor.description: Optional. The next_cursor value from the previous page, e.g. "20"; omit for the first page.

limit.description: Optional page size, 1 to 100; default 20, or 100 when brand or category is given.

name: list_models

fit_status.description: Present when there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible.

title: List laptop models
